fn execute_count(calls : List(ServiceCall), key : ActionKey) : Int =
  foldl(\(n, call) -> if call.kind == "execute" && same_key(call.key, key) then n + 1 else n, 0, calls)

fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let _ = protocol_version(get_field(obj, "protocol_version"))?
  let _ = task_name(get_field(obj, "task"))?
  parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))

fn handle_request(line : String) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  let request = map_err(\(_) -> "INVALID_INPUT", decode_lossy(line))?
  match request of
    JObj(fields) =>
      let workflow = parse_workflow(get_field(fields, "input"))?
      simulate(workflow)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn select_action(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow) : Option(Action) =
  -- Resume the oldest in-flight attempt before scanning ready pending work.
  match select_run(sim.now, true, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
    Some(action) => Some(action)
    None => select_run(sim.now, false, sim.runs, workflow.steps)

fn run_commands(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, commands : List(Command)) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match commands of
    Nil => Ok(sim)
    Cons(command, rest) =>
      let next = apply_command(sim, workflow, command)?
      run_commands(next, workflow, rest)
